errors_this_was_a_site_error_not_somethi: This was a site error, not something you did wrong. Reloading often clears it. If it keeps happening, please report it and say what you were doing when it broke.

settings_delete_everything_body_last_bac: Every profile, with its roster, teams, rotations, and lineups, the Trash, and your settings are deleted, and the page reloads. This can’t be undone. Your last backup was {when}.

settings_this_browser_isn_t_letting_crit: This browser isn’t letting critcalc read its data.
settings_it_holds_summary: It holds {summary}. Everything in this browser is replaced with it, and the page reloads.
settings_this_browser_isn_t_letting_crit: This browser isn’t letting critcalc save data.
settings_show_characters_in_their_newest: Show characters in their newest outfit if they have one.
settings_human_timing_note: {#strong}Off{/strong} times a rotation frame-perfectly, the way a macro plays it. {#strong}Padding{/strong} adds a short pause before each input the game doesn't buffer, like a skill after a normal attack or the first press after a swap. {#strong}Animations{/strong} lets every action play out instead of canceling it.
settings_how_long_that_pause_is_kqm_sugg: How long that pause is. KQM suggests 10 frames for most players; go lower if you play tight.
settings_draws_each_pause_as_a_hatched_s: Draws each pause as a hatched sliver on the timeline, so you can see where the time went.
settings_the_ping_genshin_shows_in_the_t: The ping Genshin shows in the top right. Each swap in the Planner takes your ping plus about 90 ms.
settings_shows_each_character_s_coverage: Shows each character's coverage strip under the rotation planner's notation, with the parts your rotation doesn't use yet dimmed.
settings_play_note: {#strong}Play{/strong} in the Planner’s toolbar counts you in and plays a note at each press, so you can follow along with your eyes on the game. Metronome uses one pitch; Melodic gives attacks, skills, and bursts their own notes.
settings_the_top_row_picks_which_input_g: The top row picks which input gets which note, the bottom row which three notes.
settings_a_soft_hum_while_the_next_chara: A soft hum while the next character comes in.
settings_critcalc_has_no_server_so_every: critcalc has no server, so everything you set up lives in this browser. Export a file to keep a copy or move to another device.
settings_this_browser_will_keep_your_dat: This browser will keep your data until you clear this site’s data yourself.
settings_this_browser_doesn_t_say_whethe: This browser doesn’t say whether it will keep your data. A backup keeps a copy either way.
settings_safari_may_clear_your_data_afte: Safari may clear your data after a while without a visit. Add critcalc to your Home Screen to keep it, or download a backup.
settings_this_browser_declined_so_it_may: This browser declined, so it may still clear your data on its own. A backup keeps a copy.
settings_this_browser_may_clear_your_dat: This browser may clear your data on its own, for example after a while without a visit. Ask it to keep your data, or download a backup.
settings_replaces_every_profile_in_this_: Replaces every profile in this browser, and your settings, with the ones in a backup file. Older backups work too.
settings_clear_a_profile_s_roster_rotati: Clear a profile’s roster, rotations, lineups, or teams from its own page.
settings_brings_back_the_one_time_notice: Brings back the one-time notices you’ve dismissed.
settings_removes_every_profile_the_trash: Removes every profile, the Trash, and your settings, as if you were visiting for the first time.
settings_that_doesn_t_look_like_a_critca: That doesn’t look like a critcalc backup file.
settings_that_backup_s_profiles_couldn_t: That backup’s profiles couldn’t be read.
settings_the_backup_had_no_recognizable_: The backup had no recognizable critcalc data.
